description: Initial tranche 7 baseline: browser ESM, es2020, minified, gzip level 9; 10% headroom rounded up to 100 bytes. Update only after reviewing bundle changes. Optional-reader rows added in the structured-method/docs follow-up; existing limits retained. Lazy scenarios sum emitted chunk sizes (gzip per file), with 10% deferred headroom rounded to 100 bytes; each initial static graph retains the existing Mercator limit. TypeScript default wrapper baseline added September 30, 2026 with the same headroom; existing limits retained. Automatic LazyProjection catalogue adds a separate initial/deferred budget while existing bundle limits remain unchanged. Tranche 9 compiled pipeline constants measure 17,720 gzip bytes in the rotated initial graph on Node 24.14.0; its gzip allowance increases by 100 bytes to 17,800. All other limits stay unchanged. Tranche 10 shares the optional fused batch adapter between eligible Mercator/UTM/conic plugins. Reviewed lazy initial graphs on Node 24.14.0: UTM 48,390/18,137, WKT 48,258/17,503, rotated 48,316/18,073 minified/gzip bytes; per-scenario limits rounded up to 100 bytes. Static bundle, catalogue and deferred limits remain unchanged. Tranche 12A adds the explicit vertical-height stage (+1154 minified / +317 gzip bytes for core on Node 24.14.0). Increased only exceeded limits, rounded up to 100 bytes with 100 bytes rounding headroom. Optional GTX baseline measured separately; its initial allowance is 10%. Deferred limits are unchanged. Tranche 12B1 adds an optional geoid GeoTIFF adapter: Mercator plus adapter measures 53,670 minified / 19,625 gzip bytes on Node 24.14.0 (decoder excluded), with a separate 10% allowance. Core and ordinary projection sizes are unchanged. Only the all-exports allowance increases for the new retained reader (155,646 / 53,392 bytes), rounded up to 100 bytes plus 100 bytes headroom; existing selective and lazy limits are unchanged. Tranche 12B2 optional typed pipelines measure 46,725 minified / 17,252 gzip bytes on Node 24.14.0, with a separate 10% budget. Selective core, projection and wrapper sizes/limits are unchanged. Only the all-exports allowance increases for retained pipeline orchestration (165,439 / 56,498 bytes), rounded to 100 bytes plus 100 bytes headroom. Tranche 12B3 adds exact Helmert, ordinate stacks, direction-specific steps and oblique output contracts to optional pipelines (50,629 minified / 18,686 gzip bytes on Node 24.14.0). The existing pipeline budget passes. Only the all-exports allowance increases for this retained code (169,334 / 57,866 bytes), rounded up to 100 bytes plus 100 bytes headroom. Core, wrapper, selective and lazy limits stay unchanged. Tranche 12C1 adds explicit decimal-year inputs and kinematic Helmert rates to optional pipelines (53,643 minified / 19,733 gzip bytes on Node 24.14.0). Reviewed pipeline and all-exports allowances increase only where exceeded, rounded up to 100 bytes plus 100 bytes headroom; all-exports measures 172,364 / 58,882 bytes. Core, wrapper, selective and lazy budgets stay unchanged. The 12C1 review fix conservatively rejects overlapping shared-backed epoch views even across cloned wrappers (+189 minified / +85 gzip bytes on Node 24.14.0). Pipeline measures 53,832 / 19,818 and all-exports 172,553 / 58,967 bytes. Only exceeded minified limits increase, rounded up to 100 bytes plus 100 bytes headroom; gzip, core, wrapper, selective and lazy limits stay unchanged. Tranche 13A stores mutable kinematic coefficients/epoch in owned Float64 storage and captures fixed unit/axis constants. Pipeline measures 54,012 / 19,830 bytes (+180 minified / +12 gzip versus 12C1) and all-exports 172,719 / 58,992 bytes on Node 24.14.0. Only exceeded minified pipeline/all-exports limits increase, rounded up to 100 bytes plus 100 bytes headroom. Gzip, core, wrapper, selective and lazy limits stay unchanged. Tranche 12C2 adds optional model/regular-grid and model/GeoTIFF profiles of 4074/1805 and 9171/3618 minified/gzip bytes on Node 24.14.0 (no decoder or data), each with 10% headroom. A pipeline-only import retains no model/reader code and measures 54695/20000; all-root exports measure 173460/59173. Only exceeded pipeline/all-root budgets increase, rounded up to 100 bytes plus 100 bytes headroom. Core, default wrapper, selective and lazy limits stay unchanged.
